name: TuoShou
description: The TuoShou® Trinity (佗手 / NS100) is an orthopedic and spinal surgical robotic system developed by Tuodao Medical. Integrating an active robotic positioning arm cart with a dual-camera optical navigation tracking system, the platform assists in pedicle screw placement, spinal decompression, trauma stabilization, and joint replacement. Surgeons design 3D trajectories from CT or intraoperative C-arm fluoroscopy scans, while the robotic arm aligns surgical guides to planned trajectories with real-time optical tracking feedback and servo compensation. It received China NMPA marketing approval in 2022 (Registration No. 国械注准20223011042).

publications.title: Development and Clinical Trial of a New Orthopedic Surgical Robot for Positioning and Navigation
